description: Semantic layer for NL-to-query-plan mapping over the fact_flight_info star schema and deterministic SQL compilation

origin.description: IATA airport code for the departure airport

destination.description: IATA airport code for the destination airport

country.description: Country name as stored in dim_country.f_country_name, e.g. Japan

cabin_class.description: Cabin class as stored in fact_flight_info.f_cabin_class

start_date.description: Start of departure date window in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

end_date.description: End of departure date window in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

max_price.description: Maximum acceptable fare total amount in the stored currency

min_seats.description: Minimum number of last seats available on the flight

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return

cheapest_fare.description: Lowest total fare amount across matching flights

avg_fare.description: Average fare total for a route or grouping

avg_flight_duration.description: Average flight duration in hours for matching flights

flight_count.description: Number of distinct flight combinations matching the filter

min_last_seats.description: Minimum last-seats count across matching flights (urgency indicator)

cheapest_flight_on_route.description: Find the cheapest fare for a direct route between two airports within a departure date window.
examples: What is the cheapest flight from SIN to BKK?
Find the lowest fare from SIN to BKK between 2024-06-01 and 2024-06-30.
Cheapest one-way from KUL to SIN in June 2024?
cheapest_flight_on_route.sql_template: SELECT f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS cheapest_fare, f.f_currency_code, al.f_airline_name FROM fact_flight_info f JOIN dim_airline al ON al.f_airline_code = f.f_airline_code WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, f.f_currency_code, al.f_airline_name ORDER BY cheapest_fare ASC LIMIT :limit

destinations_under_budget.description: List all reachable destinations from an origin airport whose cheapest fare falls within a maximum budget, within a departure date window.
examples: Where can I fly from SIN for under 300 in June 2024?
Show destinations from KUL below 200 between 2024-07-01 and 2024-07-31.
Flights under 150 from BKK in July 2024?
destinations_under_budget.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, da.f_airport_name, ct.f_city_name, co.f_country_name, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f JOIN dim_airport da ON da.f_airport_code = f.f_destination_airport_code JOIN dim_city ct ON ct.f_city_code = da.f_city_code JOIN dim_country co ON co.f_country_code = ct.f_country_code WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, da.f_airport_name, ct.f_city_name, co.f_country_name, f.f_currency_code HAVING MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) <= :max_price ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit

destinations_by_country_from_origin.description: List destination airports in a specific country reachable from an origin airport within a departure date window.
examples: From SIN, which airports in Thailand can I fly to in June 2024?
Show me destinations in Japan from KUL between 2024-08-01 and 2024-08-31.
Which Malaysian airports are reachable from SIN in July 2024?
destinations_by_country_from_origin.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, da.f_airport_name, ct.f_city_name, co.f_country_name, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, f.f_currency_code, MIN(date(f.f_departure_date)) AS first_departure FROM fact_flight_info f JOIN dim_airport da ON da.f_airport_code = f.f_destination_airport_code JOIN dim_city ct ON ct.f_city_code = da.f_city_code JOIN dim_country co ON co.f_country_code = ct.f_country_code WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND co.f_country_name = :country AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, da.f_airport_name, ct.f_city_name, co.f_country_name, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY first_departure ASC LIMIT :limit

route_fare_options.description: List all available fare options for a specific route and departure date window, ordered by price. Includes airline, cabin class, aircraft model, and duration.
examples: Show me all fare options from SIN to BKK in June 2024.
List available fares for KUL to SIN between 2024-07-10 and 2024-07-15.
What are the fare choices for SIN to NRT in August 2024?
route_fare_options.sql_template: SELECT f.f_flight_combination, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, f.f_total_amount_fare_total, f.f_currency_code, f.f_flight_duration, f.f_num_of_last_seats, al.f_airline_name, ac.f_aircraft_model FROM fact_flight_info f JOIN dim_airline al ON al.f_airline_code = f.f_airline_code JOIN dim_aircraft ac ON ac.f_aircraft_code = f.f_aircraft_code WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) ORDER BY f.f_total_amount_fare_total ASC LIMIT :limit

airlines_on_route.description: List all airlines operating flights between two airports within a departure date window, with their cheapest available fare. Currency is resolved at the application layer.
examples: Which airlines fly from SIN to BKK in June 2024?
What carriers operate KUL to SIN routes in July 2024?
List airlines and prices for SIN to NRT in August 2024.
airlines_on_route.sql_template: SELECT al.f_airline_code, al.f_airline_name, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, AVG(f.f_flight_duration) AS avg_duration_hours, COUNT(f.f_flight_combination) AS flight_count FROM fact_flight_info f JOIN dim_airline al ON al.f_airline_code = f.f_airline_code WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY al.f_airline_code, al.f_airline_name ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit

last_seat_urgency.description: Find flights on a route with very limited remaining seats, useful for urgency-based prompts or low-availability alerts.
examples: Are there any almost-full flights from SIN to BKK in June 2024?
Show me SIN to NRT flights with fewer than 3 seats left in July 2024.
Which KUL to SIN flights are nearly sold out this month?
last_seat_urgency.sql_template: SELECT f.f_flight_combination, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_num_of_last_seats, f.f_total_amount_fare_total, f.f_currency_code, al.f_airline_name, ac.f_aircraft_model FROM fact_flight_info f JOIN dim_airline al ON al.f_airline_code = f.f_airline_code JOIN dim_aircraft ac ON ac.f_aircraft_code = f.f_aircraft_code WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) AND f.f_num_of_last_seats <= COALESCE(:max_seats, 5) ORDER BY f.f_num_of_last_seats ASC, f.f_departure_date ASC LIMIT :limit
